tagline: The songs of Dark Tales. Full songs and single verse Shorts, in one place.

guides.title: About These Songs
guides.body: This is the music side of Dark Tales: original songs in the same shadow as the stories. Full songs sit under Videos. The Shorts are single verses and hooks, the part of the song that stays in your head.

guides.title: Hearing A Whole Song
guides.body: When a Short grabs you, its full song is in the Videos list in this app. Tap through and hear it end to end, the way it was recorded.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
